appName: Glory Unveiled: The Tabernacle of Moses
displayName: Glory Unveiled: The Tabernacle of Moses
display_name: Glory Unveiled: The Tabernacle of Moses
display_long_description:
Discover the ancient Tabernacle of Moses like never before with this groundbreaking immersive educational experience. Travel back in time to interact with one of the most revered structures in biblical history, as described in the Book of Exodus. 

Here, every detail is crafted with historical accuracy:

- Authentic Construction: The Tabernacle is meticulously modeled to reflect the exact dimensions, materials, and construction techniques of its time, from the gold-plated Ark of the Covenant to the intricately embroidered Veil.

- Interactive Learning: Engage with each element of the Tabernacle. Behold the Golden Lampstand, explore the Altar of Incense, and understand the purpose and symbolism behind each piece. 

- Deep Theological Insights: As you navigate through this holy space, learn about the profound theological meanings behind the physical items. Discover how each object symbolizes aspects of Christian theology, from redemption to divine presence.

- Educational Narratives: Integrated visual cues provide in-depth explanations, making complex religious symbols accessible and understandable, whether you're a scholar or a curious explorer.

Perfect for religious studies, history buffs, or anyone interested in the intersection of faith and art. Experience the Tabernacle not just as a structure but as a living testament to ancient faith, now brought into the modern age through the lens of virtual reality.
